description: Task breakdown for the approved Java and Spring Boot upgrade plan.

tasks.description: Upgrade the complete application to Java 21 and Spring Boot 4.0.8, subject to resolving the documented compatibility gate. Addresses assessment issue: Java Version is not the latest LTS (azure-java-version-02000).
tasks.reason: The assessment report identified Java 17 in the complete application, and the user explicitly requested Java 21 and Spring Boot 4.0.8.
tasks.requirements: Scope all application/build changes to complete/ and preserve existing behavior and tests. Explicit targets are Java 17 -> Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.5.3 -> Spring Boot 4.0.8; do not silently change either target. Before implementation, verify authoritative compatibility requirements for Spring Boot 4.0.8, Java 21, its dependency/framework/Jakarta baseline, Gradle 9, and the Spring Boot Gradle Plugin. The repository Java-upgrade guideline currently associates Boot 4.x with Java 25; if authoritative requirements confirm Java 21 is unsupported, stop before changing files and request the user's decision. Assess Gradle 9 Wrapper and plugin compatibility, deprecated/incompatible Gradle configuration, and Java sourceCompatibility versus Java Toolchain. Review Maven Parent/plugins/dependencies and Maven Wrapper compatibility. Review .github/workflows/continuous-integration-build.yml and its external reusable workflow for Java 21 plus Maven and Gradle coverage; report inaccessible or missing CI coverage rather than assuming it. After compatibility is resolved and implementation is approved, make only the minimum required compatibility changes and validate Maven Wrapper build/tests, Gradle Wrapper build/tests, and CI. Do not modify initial/ or other sample projects, generated output, or unrelated files.
